_comment: Example allocation config for scripts/deploy-vesting.js. Copy to config/allocations.json and fill in real addresses.
Buckets and schedule numbers mirror tokenomics/config.example.json; keep the two files in sync.
percent: share of total supply for this bucket (decimals allowed, max 2 decimal places). All buckets must sum to 100.
tgeUnlockPercent: share OF THIS BUCKET sent directly to the beneficiary at TGE (0-100). The rest goes into a vesting wallet.
cliffMonths: the vested part is fully locked until TGE + cliffMonths (nothing releasable before, exactly 0 at the cliff).
vestingMonths: after the cliff, the vested part is released linearly over vestingMonths (wallet start = TGE + cliff,
duration = vestingMonths). Fully unlocked at TGE + cliffMonths + vestingMonths, e.g. cliff 12 + vesting 36 = month 48.
vestingMonths = 0 with cliffMonths > 0: single unlock at TGE + cliffMonths. Both 0: everything is liquid at TGE, no wallet.
